books.title: Why Your Mortgage Moves
books.blurb: One bond yield quietly sets your home loan.
gist: The Fed sets a one-night rate between banks; a 30-year mortgage is priced off the 10-year Treasury yield plus a spread.
The Fed's rate is down 1.5 points from its peak, yet the 10-year rose to about 5.2% and mortgages to about 7.4%.
On a $300,000 loan that is about $220 a month more than a year ago.
